title: Co-Evolving Actor-Conditioned Critics for Non-Verifiable Generation
abstract: arXiv:2608.30397v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Natural-language critiques provide supervision beyond scalar rewards for non-verifiable generation, which lacks deterministic verifiers. In critique-guided refinement, a critic gives feedback on an initial response and an actor revises it. However, final revision quality does not reveal whether the critique was actually useful: a capable actor may improve without following the feedback, while valid feedback may fail if the actor cannot execute it. We frame critique as actor-conditioned revision guidance, where usefulness depends on whether the feedback helps the target actor address the intended weakness. We introduce TAIScore (Targeted Actionable Improvement Score), a reward that evaluates the instruction, initial response, critique, and revision together, assessing whether the critique targets a real weakness, whether the actor follows it, and whether the intended aspect improves. translated_title: 面向不可验证生成的行动者条件化评论家协同进化
translated_abstract: 自然语言评论为缺乏确定性验证器的不可验证生成任务提供了超越标量奖励的监督信号。在评论引导的改进过程中，评论家对初始响应给出反馈，行动者据此进行修订。然而，最终的修订质量并不能揭示评论本身是否真正有用：一个能力强的行动者可能在不遵循反馈的情况下也能改进，而有效的反馈若行动者无法执行也可能失败。我们将评论框架化为行动者条件化的修订指导，其有用性取决于反馈是否帮助目标行动者解决预期的弱点。我们提出了TAIScore（针对性可行动改进分数），这是一种联合评估指令、初始响应、评论和修订的奖励机制，用于评估评论是否针对真实弱点、行动者是否遵循该评论，以及预期方面是否得到改进。我们利用这一奖励来训练为行动者量身定制的评论家……
tldr: 该论文提出TAIScore奖励机制，将评论视为行动者条件化的修订指导，通过联合评估指令、初始响应、评论和修订来训练为特定行动者量身定制的评论家，从而提升不可验证生成任务中评论反馈的实际效用。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces TAIScore, a reward that jointly evaluates the instruction, initial response, critique, and revision to train actor-tailored critics, framing critique as actor-conditioned revision guidance for non-verifiable generation.
